title: Databricks Doubles Office Footprint at 5 Bryant Park
summary:
A provider of machine learning and data tools is growing its physical presence in New York City. Databricks is doubling the total office space it occupies at 5 Bryant Park to increase its square footage in Manhattan.

The expansion of the AI company's real estate was reported by the New York Post on Oct. 18. The firm continues to maintain its operations at the Manhattan address.
